internal_repository_audit.result: No author, edition, archival identifier, source URL, source-file hash or title-page transcription was found for SRC-02 beyond the generic source_document filename.

provenance_assessment.lineage_hypothesis: likely pre-2016/Hilton-1993 lexicographic lineage or a pre-spelling-update derivative within the same dictionary tradition
reasoning: Official SIL states the 2016 dictionary is an updated version of the 1993 dictionary with recent spelling changes.
SRC-02 and the indexed 2016 draft share highly specific lexical entries, examples and derivative architecture, while differing systematically in spellings such as c/k, hu/w and some r/l forms.
SRC-02 has 2581 entries, close to the approximately 2500 entries reported for both Hilton 1993 and Shoemaker 2016.
The repository itself explicitly separates Hilton 1993 as SRC-01 from the unidentified textual PDF SRC-02, so direct bibliographic identity cannot be asserted without file-level evidence.
prohibited_claims: Do not label SRC-02 as Hilton 1993 as an established fact.
Do not label SRC-02 as Shoemaker 2016 as an established fact.
Do not treat exact modern forms shared with Hilton citations as independent evidence until documentary dependence is resolved.
Do not treat the unresolved provenance as evidence that the lexical data are invalid; it is a source-lineage limitation.

research_effect.color_domain: Published Steffel-Hilton-Brambila comparisons remain valuable, but exact overlap between SRC-02 and Hilton forms must be treated as potentially non-independent until provenance is resolved.
research_effect.morphology: Source-internal SRC-02 annotations such as pp. remain valid documentary evidence about SRC-02 itself, regardless of unresolved bibliographic identity; their independence from Hilton must be assessed separately when used as diachronic corroboration.
